gloss: group leader; squad leader; team leader

definitions.gloss: group leader; squad leader; team leader
definitions.explanation: The leader of a small group or squad, used in schools, workplaces, the military, and neighborhood associations. A position of responsibility within a larger organization.

examples.japanese: {班長|はんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{班長|はんちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さんです。
examples.english: This month's group leader is Tanaka-san.

examples.japanese: {班長|はんちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{班員|はんいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出欠|しゅっけつ}→出欠：09604_shukketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: As group leader, I have the role of checking attendance of the group members.

notes: Common in school settings where students are divided into ⟦{班|はん}→班：03697_han⟧ (groups) for activities like lunch, cleaning, or class projects. The {班長|はんちょう} rotates among group members. Also used in ⟦{町内会|ちょうないかい}→町内会：10193_chounaikai⟧ (neighborhood associations) where the {班長|はんちょう} handles communication and dues collection. In military contexts, refers to a squad leader. Compare with {組長|くみちょう} (class leader in schools; also gang boss) and ⟦{委員長|いいんちょう}→委員長：19385_iinchou⟧ (committee chairperson).
